# gws CLI: Events +subscribe helper

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the `+subscribe` helper for Workspace Events: subscribe to events and stream them as NDJSON from the terminal, with substantial flags (`--target`, `--event-types`, `--project`, `--once`, `--cleanup`, `--no-ack`, `--output-dir`) and examples (e.g. stream `google.workspace.chat.message.v1.created` from a Chat space). Companion to `googleworkspace-cli-gws-events`, not a duplicate — the narrow streaming command vs the full API reference, same helper pattern as the lot 33 `gws-calendar` / `gws-calendar-insert` pair. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: a write command (creates Pub/Sub resources) — always confirm with the user before executing, and use `--cleanup` to remove them; requires the `gws` binary and a Google account; install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
